title: Lorentz harmonic maps into the hyperbolic plane and spacelike surfaces in anti-de Sitter 3-space
summary: We study the relationship between Lorentz harmonic maps into the hyperbolic plane and spacelike surfaces in anti-de Sitter 3-space. Using loop group techniques, we develop a DPW-type representation for Lorentz harmonic maps and provide an explicit solution of the associated Cauchy problem in terms of a pair of potentials. We then establish a correspondence between Lorentz harmonic maps and spacelike immersions in anti-de Sitter space, identifying conditions under which a harmonic map arises as the Gauss map of a surface.
